account: Effective privilege or impersonation needs separate evidence.
Administrative account maintenance, a pre-existing privileged session, or an external identity policy
ssh_trust: A trust update does not establish authentication.
Authorized key rotation, an accepted key, a short-lived certificate, or centralized policy
schedule: A definition change does not establish scheduler activation.
An approved backup job, a modified task, service timers, or an external controller
service: A store change does not establish service activation.
Package management, an existing service, a supervisor, or a workload restart policy
sensitive_read: The fixture does not establish disclosure of real data.
Authorized backup, a broker response, a projected secret, a cache, or an earlier copy
host_write: The canary does not establish exploitation.
Authorized maintenance, a direct workload action, or an instrumented helper
process: Creation does not establish a later command effect.
An authorized launch, independent job dispatch, or an in-process operation without a child
file_read: A completed read does not establish exfiltration.
Authorized reads, in-process reads, and delegated or cached results
service_exchange: An observed send does not establish every downstream step.
Existing session reuse, a broker handoff, or an application-computed result

studies.title: Gate C · Host writes
studies.source: Frozen controlled canary capture and replay
studies.description: The delegated path confirmed a host effect with helper, policy and outcome evidence.
studies.limit: Zero direct confirmations. The measured observer did not establish the direct operation and mutation binding.

studies.title: Gate B · Attribution validation
studies.source: Frozen Gate B fixtures and replay
studies.description: Synthetic workloads take direct and delegated paths to the same fixed host write.
studies.limit: The fixture supplies stronger identity and completion evidence than native collectors usually provide.

studies.title: Windows · Process execution
studies.description: An independently identified child creation can be tied to a specific instrumented request.
studies.limit: The lab used exact instance proofs and markers. WMI was a separate local comparison, without adjudicating exact process starts. No production rates were measured.

caseNotes.sysmon: Independent Sysmon creation and exact request-instance binding
caseNotes.wmi: Four polling observations across 11 starts; exact confirmation unavailable

studies.title: PHP · Shared file effect
studies.description: A child and an in-process worker both read the same designated file. A delegated result followed a different observation path.
studies.limit: Local per-process tracing measured controlled file reads. Runtime-only computation and delegated worker internals were incompletely visible.

caseNotes.child: Completed read, exact file identity and independent fixed result
caseNotes.worker: Complete worker read and independent result bound to the request
caseNotes.admin: Genuine read on the approved route
caseNotes.delegate: Unique job key plus independently verified destination result
